completion_data.completion_summary: Added routing sections to lean, nvim, and typst extension manifests so task types correctly resolve to specialized research and implementation skills.

memory_candidates.content: Extension manifests must include a 'routing' section mapping task types to specialized skills per phase (research/implement). Without it, tasks fall through to generic agents. The routing object structure is: routing.{phase}.{task_type} = 'skill-name'. Plan phase typically falls back to generic skill-planner.

memory_candidates_harvested.disposition: reviewed; folded into consolidated cross-task memories
